deactivate: Each CLI invocation exits and starts no persistent service; project test servers must be shut down by the test owner. The locked runtime stays dormant in private state.
lock_resolution: Exact top-level artifact integrity verified from the official npm registry. Resolve transitive/platform dependencies once at commissioning, save package-lock.json, and never auto-update an existing lock.
compatibility_basis: Reviewed source is1.66.0-next;1.65.0 is the explicitly resolved prior stable target. Only demonstrated target flows are accepted; no claim that later source-only features were tested.
